heading: Features
paragraphs: The Rental Agreement is the key part of the software which helps to collect and store all required information for car rental and also supports car replacement. Even with damage marking in and out.
You can directly get an invoice from the rental agreement page.
You can start tracking your report from the dashboard once the agreement is created.
It helps to keep track of the Maintenance history and Maintenance cost history of the vehicle.
If you want to transfer your car to another branch, you can use the branch transfer section. It will automatically update the branch of the car after the transfer is done.
If your car taken by staff or yourself and if it's non-revenue it can be entered into a Non Revenue Agreement
You can access every information from the dashboard ,vehicle count, branch wise count and many more ...
The app supports 20+ Master screens. You can enter common information in masters, and it can be selected in agreement. So you don't have to type everything again and again.
You can personalize the look and feel of the applications
We provide a database backup option to the customer. Customers can directly download backup from settings. It can be used to recover if something happens.

You Can generate 20+ reports from the application Fleet Related Reports, Agreement Reports, Revenue Reports, Vehicle Maintenance Reports, Non Revenue Reports, Booking Report. It helps to keep track of everything you need.
If you received a fine, no problem, you can search by vehicle number and fine date to find the customer details.
